title: Physics AI Internship (Summer 2027) United States Off-site Category: Interns/Temp Posted: 10/29/2026 Job ID: 19536
description: We Are Drive technology innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology drives the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, where smart tech and AI are seamlessly woven into daily life. From self-driving cars and health-monitoring smartwatches to renewable energy systems that efficiently distribute clean power, Synopsys creates high-performance silicon chips that help build a healthier, safer, and more sustainable world. Internship Experience At Synopsys, interns dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while collaborating with our passionate teams worldwide—and having fun in the process! You'll have the freedom to share your ideas, unleash your creativity, and explore your interests. This is your opportunity to bring your solutions to life and work with cutting-edge technology that shapes not only the future of innovation but also your own career path. Join us and start shaping your future today! Mission Statement Our mission is to fuel today’s innovations and spark tomorrow’s creativity. Together, we embrace a growth mindset, empower one another, and collaborate to achieve our shared goals. Every day, we live by our values of Integrity, Excellence, Leadership, and Passion, fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive—both at work and beyond. What You’ll Be Doing Engage in cutting-edge research at the intersection of deep learning, scientific computing, and foundation models for physics applications. Contribute to the development of Large Physics Foundation Models (LPFMs) by exploring novel architectures and innovative training strategies. Build and curate large-scale physics datasets, and design the infrastructure needed to support data-driven AI research in the physical sciences. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams of researchers and engineers, sharing your ideas and learning from leading experts in the field. Present findings, participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, and help shape the direction of AI for the physical sciences. What You’ll Need Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Strong passion for applying AI and deep learning to scientific or physics-based problems. Experience with scientific computing, machine learning frameworks, and large-scale data management. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Self-motivated, creative, and eager to contribute to high-impact research and engineering projects. Key Program Facts: Program Length: 3-4 months Location: Sunnyvale, California, United States Working Model: In-office, hybrid or remote Full-Time/Part-Time: Full-time Start Date: May / June 2027 Equal Opportunity Statement Synopsys is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants to apply, regardless of age, color, family or medical leave, gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, race and ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please reach out to us.

title: Intern – Manufacturing Engineer (Studying Bachelor or Master's Degree)
location: BangPa-in, PHRA NAKHON SI AYUTTHAYA, th
description: Company Description WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Description The Engineering Intern (Master's Level) will join Western Digital's Head Backend Business Unit for a structured 3-6 month internship at the Thailand site (THO). This role is designed for graduate students who bring advanced engineering knowledge and research experience, and who are expected to contribute at a higher technical level than undergraduate interns.  Interns will be embedded in the THO Engineering organization, assigned a senior engineer mentor, and expected to lead a defined technical project with measurable outcomes. High-performing interns will be considered for conversion to the ECT - under the BEST Program.  ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: • Conducting a defined engineering or process improvement project with clear scope and deliverables  • Applying graduate-level technical knowledge to real manufacturing challenges in slider/HGA operations  • Performing data analysis, technical documentation, and experiment design under mentor guidance  • Presenting findings to engineering team at mid-point and program close  • Contributing technical insights that can be carried forward post-internship  • Participating in structured learning sessions, assessments, and IDP-lite conversations   Qualifications REQUIRED: Currently pursuing in Master's degree program in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science , or related field Completed Bachelor's degree in engineering or technical discipline Strong academic record with active thesis or research project Available for 3-6 months structured internship PREFERRED: Thesis or research project related to manufacturing, materials, process optimization, or precision engineering Experience with experimental design, statistical analysis, or process simulation Exposure to L ean, Six Sigma, or quality engineering methodologies Prior industry internship or research collaboration with a manufacturing firm SKILLS: Advanced technical problem-solving and research skills Data analysis proficiency (Minitab, Python, MATLAB, or equivalent) Strong written and verbal English communication Ability to independently manage a project workstream Collaborative and professional conduct in a manufacturing environment This position is part of our Early Career program at WD. Our Early Career program is designed to support individuals beginning their professional career by providing the foundational training through a structured onboarding, mentorship, and development curriculum.
